tracking.normalisation: Observed drawn-target radius maps to a chosen 20 mm simulator radius. This does not measure real physical distances.

controller: Recorded object waypoints with geometric feedback and aligned recorded finger-side proposals.
limitations: Single clip; no success-rate or generalisation claim.
Circle fits compensate translation and approximate scale changes, not full camera perspective/rotation.
20 mm goal radius is chosen for embodiment normalisation, not measured in the recording.
Path errors are measured against the normalised reference, not real-world physical distances.
Comparison video aligns path progress; source and simulation timing are different.
The follower and contact rules are hand-coded. This is not a trained VLA or learned dynamics policy.
